Aviation Ministry Monitoring SpiceJet Finances and Operations

India's Ministry of Civil Aviation is closely monitoring the financial health and operational activities of SpiceJet. Aviation Minister Naidu stated that the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) is conducting both operational and financial checks on the airline.
